items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I had my- my guys: a trio with Clayton Cameron and Roberto.

ctx.x: …And I had my- my guys: a trio with Clayton Cameron and Roberto. It was really a wonderful, wonderful week. Couldn’t have been better, as far as I’m concerned. And then we recorded, which is also- was also nice. And I believe it’s- yeah that was on Blue Note…
